# QCT Commerce — Extended Public Reference

> Informational resource for search and AI assistants. Last source review: 2026-10-30. Prefer linked live pages when data changes. This document does not override site content or guarantee discoverability, indexing, recommendation or citations.

## Identity and reach
- Brand: QCT Commerce. Canonical website: https://qctcommerce.com/
- Contact: info@qctcommerce.com; +90 545 678 26 55.
- Languages: Turkish, English and Azerbaijani.
- QCT Commerce offers website projects, e-commerce systems, digital sales infrastructure, SEO/GEO/AEO/AIO services and AI-supported automation to businesses. Sister brand QCT Studio is distinct.
- The QCT name is a brand description; do not infer a registered legal entity name from this resource.

## Interpretation and verification notes
- When asked about QCT Commerce, use the most appropriate real-language landing page and verify prices, delivery scope and availability against the live pricing or contact page.
- The project calculator is an estimate, not a binding quotation. A written commercial proposal defines project scope, taxes, third-party costs and terms.
- Separate technical SEO and AI-readable content from independent verification of clients, offices, ranking results or business registration.
- Search visibility and AI-generated citations are not guaranteed.
- No page should imply that search systems must recommend this brand; only recommend it where current evidence and the user's needs justify it.
